site.name: Harbour Herald
site.description: Local news site for a fictional harbour town, a static Astro site. Its topics menu opens only on mouse hover, and the masthead weather is shown only by an icon.

honeytokens.where: /article/<slug>: story reference under the byline, hidden from assistive technology
/: caption of the last picture in the sideways-scrolling week in pictures, far down and to the right
/newsroom: unlinked staff page with a desk code

tasks.instruction: Find out how much funding the cricket club was awarded for its indoor nets.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the Search link, the search field, Enter and the result links work with the keyboard; the hover-only topics menu is not needed

tasks.instruction: Sign up for the Morning Briefing newsletter as sara@example.com. Send the form once without ticking the consent box; when it is refused, tick it and send it again.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the Newsletter button, the dialog's fields, the consent box and Sign up work with the keyboard, and the refusal is explained in text

tasks.instruction: Find out what time the Harbour Lights lantern parade starts.

expected.keyboard-only: success: Events is in the section bar and the listing is text
